# OpenAQ approved expectations

`phase2i5-approved.json` contains the public expectations approved by Spheros
Environmental at `2026-08-12T06:53:00-07:00`. It was promoted mechanically
from the independently derived OpenAQ worksheet after source, worksheet,
derivation, and frozen-measurement hashes were verified. Current CompassAQ
output is not stored in the expectation bundle.

The hash-bound source facts and worksheet are retained in
`backend/tests/fixtures/reference_data/provenance/phase2i5/` so the loader can
continue to validate the bundle without generated review output.
